Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown

Women Empowerment – Mukkamaar Self-Defence Training

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown conducted a Mukkamaar self-defence and training session at Dayanand Balika Vidyalaya, Matunga, as part of its Women Empowerment initiative.

The session focused on teaching students practical self-defence techniques, awareness and confidence, helping them feel better prepared to protect themselves in situations where their safety may be at risk.

Such training empowers young girls not only with physical skills but also with courage, confidence and self-reliance.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown remains committed to creating opportunities that empower the younger generation and help them lead safer and more confident lives.

Empower. Educate. Protect.
Together, We Create Lasting Impact.
